Context-dependent error model results for the **pacbio** platform.

```{python}
#| tags: [parameters]
results_dir = "../context_error_models"
platform = "pacbio"
artifact_glob = "*.pt"
max_volcano_points = 50000
top_parameters = 80
max_heatmap_contexts = 80
heatmap_context_sample = 500
show_per_model_plots = True
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
from pathlib import Path

RESULTS_DIR = Path(results_dir).expanduser()
PLATFORM = str(platform)
ARTIFACT_GLOB = str(artifact_glob)
MAX_VOLCANO_POINTS = int(max_volcano_points)
TOP_PARAMETERS = int(top_parameters)
MAX_HEATMAP_CONTEXTS = int(max_heatmap_contexts)
HEATMAP_CONTEXT_SAMPLE = int(heatmap_context_sample)
SHOW_PER_MODEL_PLOTS = str(show_per_model_plots).lower() not in ("false", "0", "no")

print(f"Results directory : {RESULTS_DIR.resolve()}")
print(f"Platform filter   : {PLATFORM}")
print(f"Per-model plots   : {SHOW_PER_MODEL_PLOTS}")
```
